rule.text: The project stopped work on this pending function and recorded why. It is never ported, never tested equivalent and never added to the verified count. Approved by Glib on Oct 28, 2026 (stop the ledger tail).

reasons.needs_callee_footprint_model: One direction is infeasible by reading the code, but the proof needed a callee-footprint model that was removed after review found gaps.
reasons.needs_multi_cell_or_aliased_state: The search reached everything except a few jump directions that need three or more cells to line up (a pointer aliasing the function's own pushes, wrapped address arithmetic, tail jumps with moved stacks), and the prover answers reachable.
reasons.partial_coverage_gate_not_built: Scenarios cover part of the function; the remaining code sits behind a gate whose state was not built (see the note for the coverage reached).
reasons.prover_window_times_out: Scenarios cover everything that can run; the remaining directions are provably impossible in principle (loops and copies of equal data) but every prover window times out.

0x471722.note: Scenarios cover every instruction (1151) and 173 of 174 directions; the last, 0x4721d3 taken, needs byte [obj+0xd3b] nonzero, but the function only ever writes it 0 and clears it before the compare, so it needs a heap-field invariant or an alias of two object pointers that the prover cannot express.

0x496410.note: 24 KB rasterizer; generic fuzz hits the instruction limit (about 15,700 passes of the loop at 0x4966ee). The loop exits only when [this+0x50e1] or [this+0x50e5] has bit 0x1000000 set and bits 0x10000000 and 0x20000000 clear, derived from the polygon and edge tables, so it needs a model of those tables. Baseline 366 of 4,985 instructions and 10 of 534 directions.

0x4a14c6.note: One direction left; a copy is compared against its own source. Coverage reached: 437 of 437 instructions, 45 of 46 jump directions.

0x4e812f.note: 10 directions and 39 instructions left, behind loops at 0x4e8212 and 0x4e851f; every window times out.

0x50e05d.note: x87 cos wrapper: the missing directions depend on the zero flag left by the caller before fnstcw, the control word from fnstcw, x87 status flags after the operation, and jumps to 0x513cbe and 0x513ccb outside the row span, whose edges the world does not record.

0x50e10d.note: x87 sin wrapper: the missing directions depend on the zero flag left by the caller before fnstcw, the control word from fnstcw, x87 status flags after the operation, and jumps to 0x513cbe and 0x513ccb outside the row span, whose edges the world does not record.

0x5110a9.note: The printf _output state-table loop. 5115fa fall-through is proved by a window; 511152 taken, 5113a0 fall-through and 5114e4 taken are left. The main-loop invariant atoms time out in z3 at 120 s, and the table reads need a rule for a table of the constant image at a generalised loop header. All three are feasible with crafted format strings, so they are a scenario-generator item, not a prover rule.

0x5152b9.note: 515572 taken needs edi != -1 at 0x51545d, an index range invariant of the search loop at 0x5153xx; the loop plan did not settle. Same family as 0x516f69.

0x516f69.note: Scenarios reach 395 of 417 instructions; the prover proves 516fc6 taken and 517246 fall-through. 517225 taken is left: it needs an invariant that ties the byte [edi] to '+' or '-' whenever the state in eax is 11; the digit-buffer pointer [ebp-0xc] is a stored pointer cell, so it needs an alias model for stores through that cell, and a register value-set atom alone is not inductive.

0x519009.note: 5190d2 taken needs the invariant counter > 0 at the header of the outer loop plus a footprint for the call to 0x518bd5, which receives a frame address through the pointer cell [ebp-4]; 51916c taken needs a value-range invariant for a 16-bit word computed by a loop. The prover answers sat for both.
